extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief) used for?
faqs.a: A frac sand silo stores proppant at the well site and delivers it to the blender. This vertical round silo holds 200 tonnes nominal, with hydraulic cylinders for controlled tilt, so chute delivery gives a constant sand flow.

faqs.q: What capacity does the 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief) have?
faqs.a: It has a nominal capacity of 200 tonnes. Horizontal, square and multi-compartment configurations are available, so state the proppant volume and the number of grades on the RFQ.

faqs.q: How does the 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief) discharge sand?
faqs.a: Hydraulic knife-gate valves and doors regulate discharge into the blender, and the hydraulic tilt gives chute delivery with constant flow. A sand-belt-conveyor delivery replaces the tilt on fixed installations.

faqs.q: What configurations of sand silo are available besides the 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief)?
faqs.a: Horizontal, square and multi-compartment configurations are available, with sand-belt-conveyor delivery in place of tilt for fixed-installation sites. Onshore or offshore configurations are available on request.

faqs.q: Is the 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief) available for offshore use?
faqs.a: Onshore or offshore configurations are available on request for the Sand Chief silo. State the site, any crane limits and the approvals needed on the RFQ so the configuration is quoted correctly.

faqs.q: What does the 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief) connect to?
faqs.a: It discharges into the [frac blender](/p/frac-blender-mfr-50-50-bbl-min-auto-density-control-chemical-additive-system) and is filled by bulk sand delivery. See [frac blenders](/c/frac-blender) and [frac transfer pumps](/c/frac-transfer-pumps) for the downstream equipment.

faqs.q: How does the 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief) differ from a frac tank?
faqs.a: The sand silo stores dry proppant, while a [frac tank](/p/frac-tank-500-bbl-insulated-trailer-mounted-road-registered) stores liquid. Both are needed on a frac site, one for each material.

faqs.q: Where is the 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief) used?
faqs.a: It is used on hydraulic fracturing sites to hold proppant ahead of the blender. See the guide on [frac and stimulation equipment](/blog/frac-and-stimulation-equipment) and [frac sand silos](/c/frac-sand-silos).

faqs.q: What should I send for a frac sand silo quotation?
faqs.a: Send the proppant capacity, the configuration (vertical, horizontal or multi-compartment), the discharge method, and whether the site is onshore or offshore.

faqs.q: How is the 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief) set up for delivery to the blender?
faqs.a: Hydraulic cylinders tilt the vertical silo for controlled chute delivery, and hydraulic knife-gate valves and doors regulate discharge into the blender. This keeps sand flowing constantly, and a belt conveyor replaces the tilt on fixed sites.

faqs.q: What does the Sand Chief name mean for a frac sand silo?
faqs.a: Sand Chief is the product name for this vertical round, hydraulic-tilt silo design with knife-gate discharge. It is a descriptive name, not a certification.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief)?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 200 t frac sand silo (Sand Chief) as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send your configuration and destination through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
